en: You took too much in the boss fight: watch the attack hints, dash on red rings and ripples, or bring a defense/heal card first.

en: Streaks rarely passed ×50: don't wait in open ground; skirt the edge of the crowd and the XP bonus snowballs.
zh: 连斩很少超过 ×50:别在空地等怪,主动贴着怪群边缘走,经验加成会滚起来。

en: Normal attack · Legendary. Flying swords from the case stay with you, dive at enemies on their own and return.
zh: 普攻·神兵:剑匣中飞出数柄飞剑常伴左右,自行俯冲斩敌,再飞回身边。

en: Normal attack · Legendary. Raise the token: thunder strikes the toughest enemies nearby and arcs to their neighbours.
zh: 普攻·神兵:令牌一举,天雷劈向附近生命最高的数名敌人,并跳击旁人。

en: Normal attack · Legendary. The note becomes a long beam through every enemy in a line, slowing them; it grows the longer you hold it.
zh: 普攻·神兵:笛声凝成一道长光束,贯穿一线所有敌人并减速,吹得越久越强。

en: Normal attack · Legendary. A great bell drops onto the crowd, stunning it and ringing out a shockwave.
zh: 普攻·神兵:巨钟从天而降砸向敌群,震晕并荡出钟波。

en: Normal attack · Legendary. Golden gu stay with you, biting to stack poison and drain life; their kills hatch more.
zh: 普攻·神兵:金蚕常伴,扑咬敌人叠毒并吸血;它们杀死的敌人会孵出新蚕。

en: Normal attack. Crescent cuts that pierce everything ahead; every third is a cross-cut that leaves a lingering scar.
zh: 普攻:向前斩出贯穿的月牙刀光,每第三刀十字斩并留下刀痕。

en: Normal attack. Hook a distant foe, yank the whole line to you, then spin the sickle through them.
zh: 普攻:锁链钩住远处的敌人,把一线敌人拽到身前,再回旋一镰。

en: Normal attack · Legendary. Paper-crane spirits stay with you and dive through enemies on their own.
zh: 普攻·神兵:召出纸鹤式神常伴左右,自行俯冲穿刺敌人。

en: Blink-dash through the crowd with a heavy cut; an afterimage cuts them again.
zh: 瞬身穿过敌群重斩,刀光过后再补一刀残影。

en: Five foxfires hunt enemies on their own for six seconds and set them burning.
zh: 放出五团狐火,六秒内自行追击敌人并灼烧。

en: A seal on the thickest crowd: everything inside is held fast and takes 25% more damage, then it detonates.
zh: 在敌群脚下结下封印:定住其中敌人并使其受伤 +25%,两秒后引爆。

en: For four seconds blade-petals fall all around you, cutting everything nearby.
zh: 四秒内樱花刀刃如雪落下,不断斩切周围敌人。

en: Normal attack. A heart beam that bounces from enemy to enemy; more bounces as it levels.
zh: 普攻:爱心光束在敌人之间弹射,等级越高弹得越多。

en: Normal attack. Sings a cone of sound; every fourth is a high note that turns enemies to your side.
zh: 普攻:向前唱出扇形声浪,每第四声飙出高音,让敌人倒戈。

en: Normal attack · Legendary. Fireworks burst on the crowd and scatter a ring of star shards.
zh: 普攻·神兵:向敌群射出烟火,炸开后再迸出一圈星屑。

en: A fan of hearts: anything hit is charmed for three seconds and attacks its own side.
zh: 抛出一扇爱心:被击中的敌人着迷三秒,转身攻击同伴。

en: For three seconds: +40% speed, 30% less damage taken, and a stage shockwave on every beat.
zh: 三秒内移速 +40%,受伤 -30%,每拍震出一圈舞台冲击。

en: For six seconds all damage +30%, and every kill restores HP and qi.
zh: 六秒内全部伤害 +30%,每次击杀回复生命与内力。

en: A confetti blast that hits hard and charms nearby enemies, and instantly resets your other skills.
zh: 彩带炸开重伤周围、让附近敌人着迷,并立刻刷新其他武学冷却。

en: Normal attack. A slow arcane orb that passes through everything, zapping enemies around it as it flies.
zh: 普攻:缓慢飞行的奥术法球,穿透一切,沿途不断电击周围敌人。

en: Normal attack. Fireballs explode on impact and set everything in the blast alight.
zh: 普攻:火球命中后爆炸,点燃范围内的敌人。

en: Normal attack · Legendary. Calls meteors onto the crowd, leaving burning craters.
zh: 普攻·神兵:召下陨星砸向敌群,留下燃烧的陨坑。

en: Teleport a short distance; arcane bursts at both ends.
zh: 瞬移一段距离,起点与落点各炸开一团奥术。

zh: 在敌群中心撕开黑洞,三秒内吸入并碾压,最后坍缩爆炸。

en: A moon-cutting katana and binding seals: a fast, bursty demon hunter from the east.
zh: 妖刀斩月,结界封魔;以快打快的退魔剑士。

en: Bouncing heart beams and a wink that turns monsters on each other: the stage is yours.
zh: 爱心弹射,一个眨眼让怪物倒戈;舞台属于你。

en: Arcane orbs, frost and black holes: a spellcaster from the far west.
zh: 奥术法球、冰霜与黑洞;来自西方的大法师。

en: True Five Thunders: +2 strikes, each arcs once more
zh: 五雷正法·落雷 +2,每道雷多跳一次

zh: 晨钟暮鼓·双钟齐落,眩晕 +0.6s

en: Gu King: +3 silkworms, bites stack two poison
zh: 蛊王·金蚕 +3,啃咬叠两层毒
